authorized_scope: User requested bounded QuantConnect sector comparison; four fixed cases, no tuning
technical_repairs_only: Four matched reruns after pending-sale rejection; all earlier completed controls excluded from final comparison
universe_rationale: Fixed ten-sector ETF set including XLRE, excluding later XLC. 2017 begins after full 252-return XLRE lookback; not exact tutorial code replication. Sector classification and fund constituents change historically.
momentum: Monthly first session: top three by 252-session total-return close ratio, equal weights, deterministic ticker tie break; no skip, absolute momentum filter or gate overlay
equal: Monthly first session: equal weight all ten sector ETFs
hold: SPY entry once, cash dividends retained
gate: Original combined GateCore on raw SPY, seeded from 2004, daily green1/yellow0.5/red0 target; unchanged recovery counters
execution: All cases: raw daily QC subscriptions, prior close sized next MOO, whole shares, 98% target gross budget, no shorting. IB simulation margin-account plumbing with leverage2 credit limit (actual target gross98%, assert closing gross<=1) allows sale proceeds reuse; assert nonnegative closing cash and exposure<=1. No financing/interest/tax model.
signal_normalization: Momentum history requests TOTAL_RETURN only; account uses RAW and native dividend/split handling. No market data exported.
primary_estimand: Net CAGR difference: momentum minus SPY and equal-weight sectors
diagnostics: full CAGR or annual return divided by absolute drawdown
evaluation_status: Viewed historical development sample, not untouched holdout
stops: negative closing cash or gross leverage
incomplete output or inconsistent calendar/annual compounding
exports: Summary statistics and provenance only; no raw prices, daily NAV, reconstructable series or obfuscation
amendment_reason: Momentum MOO purchase rejected before pending sale released buying power. Change only simulated credit limit; rerun all four cases. No rule, cost, dates, target or ranking change. User-authorized comparison requires completed matched execution. Original six-attempt protocol preserved; amendment made before its exhaustion.
